comment: Ymir-owned files. These are OUR additions to the pi-desktop fork — the sync script never copies upstream over them and never deletes them on rsync. Everything else under apps/sessrumnir/ is upstream-owned and refreshed on each sync.
comment_2026_11_19: Extended when Sessrúmnir left Ymir for its own repo: a --check dry run against upstream showed a sync would delete every Ymir addition made since September (the app contract, themes/, public/, the width probe, the bottom-anchored scroll) and overwrite install.sh, which upstream also ships (its curl installer is scripts/quick-install.sh here).
